parameters.query: SELECT id AS company_id, name, ats_type, slug, COALESCE(api_base,'') AS api_base, (ats_type || ':' || slug) AS board, COALESCE(etag,'') AS etag FROM companies WHERE is_active AND next_poll_at <= now() ORDER BY next_poll_at ASC LIMIT 25

INSERT INTO jobs (company_id, board, external_id, title, jd_text, location, remote, apply_url, posted_at, embedding, status, last_seen) VALUES ($1,$2,$3,$4,$5,$6,$7,$8, NULLIF($9,'')::timestamptz, NULLIF($10,'')::vector, 'active', now()) ON CONFLICT (board, external_id) DO UPDATE SET title=EXCLUDED.title, jd_text=EXCLUDED.jd_text, location=EXCLUDED.location, remote=EXCLUDED.remote, apply_url=EXCLUDED.apply_url, posted_at=EXCLUDED.posted_at, embedding=COALESCE(EXCLUDED.embedding, jobs.embedding), last_seen=now(), status='active', closed_at=NULL
UPDATE jobs SET status='closed', closed_at=now() WHERE board = ANY(string_to_array($1, ',')) AND status='active' AND last_seen < $2::timestamptz

UPDATE companies SET last_polled_at = now(), consecutive_failures = 0, etag = COALESCE(e.etag, companies.etag), relevant_yield = relevant_yield + GREATEST(e.relevant, 0), poll_interval = CASE WHEN e.relevant >= 3 THEN LEAST(poll_interval, interval '3 hours') WHEN e.relevant >= 1 THEN LEAST(poll_interval, interval '24 hours') WHEN e.relevant = 0 AND tier = 'probe' THEN interval '30 days' ELSE poll_interval END, tier = CASE WHEN tier = 'dream' THEN 'dream' WHEN e.relevant >= 3 THEN 'hot' WHEN e.relevant >= 1 AND tier <> 'hot' THEN 'warm' WHEN e.relevant = 0 AND tier = 'probe' THEN 'cold' ELSE tier END, next_poll_at = now() + (CASE WHEN e.relevant >= 3 THEN LEAST(poll_interval, interval '3 hours') WHEN e.relevant >= 1 THEN LEAST(poll_interval, interval '24 hours') WHEN e.relevant = 0 AND tier = 'probe' THEN interval '30 days' ELSE poll_interval END) FROM jsonb_to_recordset($1::jsonb) AS e(board text, etag text, relevant int) WHERE (companies.ats_type || ':' || companies.slug) = e.board

parameters.content:
## ATS Poller
Schedule → select due boards → fetch ATS (text) → parse (cap 25/board) → chunk → batch-embed via Ollama /api/embed → upsert jobs → close vanished (liveness) → advance poll.

Failure bookkeeping: ok boards advance + save etag; failed boards back off exponentially (cap 7d) and deactivate after 5 strikes; 404/410 deactivate immediately; 304 advances without liveness diff.

Ollama URL/model hardcoded (n8n blocks $env in expressions). Postgres cred pre-bound. bge-m3 pulled by ollama-init.

parameters.query: UPDATE companies SET consecutive_failures = consecutive_failures + 1, last_polled_at = now(), next_poll_at = now() + LEAST(poll_interval * POWER(2, LEAST(consecutive_failures + 1, 6)), interval '7 days'), is_active = CASE WHEN (ats_type || ':' || slug) = ANY(string_to_array($2, ',')) THEN false ELSE (consecutive_failures + 1) < 5 END WHERE (ats_type || ':' || slug) = ANY(string_to_array($1, ',')) OR (ats_type || ':' || slug) = ANY(string_to_array($2, ','))
